blocks.text: Your mobile number will be blocked in 2 hours due to illegal activity.
Press 9 to speak to the officer.

callouts: An unknown or foreign number posing as TRAI.
A short deadline is meant to panic you.
Pressing a key connects you to the scammer.
Hang up and report it on Chakshu.

blocks.text: Sir, refund is stuck. Please install AnyDesk and share the code.
Approve the request with your UPI PIN to receive the refund.
Now tell me the OTP you received.

callouts: Screen-sharing apps let them see your OTPs.
A collect request takes money, it never pays you.
A PIN is only for sending money.
No real agent asks for an OTP.
Find helplines only in the official app or site.
